# InterDigital at MWC 2026 InterDigital showcased groundbreaking 6G, AI, AR, and haptic innovations at MWC Barcelona. Explore demos shaping the future of wireless, immersive tech, and connected services. March 2026 InterDigital Comms [AI](https://www.interdigital.com/blog?tags=AI)[MWC26](https://www.interdigital.com/blog?tags=MWC26)[Video](https://www.interdigital.com/blog?tags=Video)[Wireless](https://www.interdigital.com/blog?tags=Wireless) Every year, InterDigital attends MWC in Barcelona to showcase the cutting-edge innovation and technological leadership fostered within our[Research and Innovation Labs](https://www.interdigital.com/research-and-innovation) . InterDigital’s MWC showcase is the culmination of months of work and collaboration to provide tangible, interactive examples of the impact of InterDigital’s wireless, video, and AI expertise. This year’s show was anchored in InterDigital research and innovation that is shaping 6G and empowering more devices, more AI-enabled services, and richer, immersive experiences at scale. Dive in to explore what we showed: ## Demos **Leading 6G Research** : Our experts previewed some of InterDigital’s future-looking research, including the ways Extreme MIMO and Near Field will expand network capacity, Service Aware Radio Access can significantly improve quality of experience for an array of services, and GenAI Convergence can natively integrate communication and computing to support more Gen AI in the 6G era. Learn how InterDigital is[leading the path to 6G research](https://www.interdigital.com/post/how-interdigital-is-leading-the-path-to-6g)
**Interactive AR Experiences** : We welcomed guests into an interactive augmented reality world enabled by InterDigital’s contributions to 3GPP and MPEG’s Scene Description, Avatar, and Haptic standards, which together enhance immersivity, realism, and deepen engagement in AR environments.
**Collaborative Sensing** : Our experts introduced[InterDigital and Türk Telekom's partnership](https://ir.interdigital.com/news-events/press-releases/news-details/2026/InterDigital-and-Trk-Telekom-Achieve-Worlds-First-Collaborative-Cellular-and-Wi-Fi-Sensing-Using-Preliminary-6G-Architecture/default.aspx) to achieve the world’s first implementation of collaborative Wi-Fi and cellular sensing using a proposed 6G architecture. This milestone reveals the potential for real-time, continuous results for sensing services, especially for applications like smart manufacturing, healthcare, situational awareness, and more. Dive into the research milestone with[Türk Telekom here](https://youtu.be/Qr0-isI9sa0)
**AI-enabled Teleoperation** : We demonstrated the potential of AI-enabled services through the lens of a remote vehicle operator navigating an autonomous vehicle around a car crash amid poor network conditions, and whose job is complemented by GenAI and AI agents that maintain consistent quality of video delivery to ensure safe navigation.
**Haptic-enabled Streaming** : Our experts showcased how InterDigital’s haptic innovation and partnership with Razer, a leading gamer lifestyle brand, is enabling the delivery of haptic-enabled content at scale. The partners have also launched the[Haptic Excellence Center](https://s3.amazonaws.com/files.interdigital.com/55bd0288af0b0930ba599bd0c4b7ca38/resources/uploads/MWC26/ID-Haptic-Excellence-Center.pdf) to encourage haptics adoption through education and standardization. Learn how InterDigital is:[Revealing the Magic of](https://www.interdigital.com/post/revealing-the-magic-of-haptics)[Haptics](https://www.interdigital.com/post/revealing-the-magic-of-haptics)
## Watch InterDigital's Chief Technology Officer, Rajesh Pankaj, introduces the ways 6G innovation will complement AI and address critical problems to expand the impact of AI around the world. ` ` Head of Wireless Labs, Milind Kulkarni, explains mobile AI's inflection point and the InterDigital innovation underpinning its success. ## ICYMI Throughout MWC, we welcomed partners, industry peers, and government officials from across the U.S. and EU, including esteemed guests from the European Commission, Turkish delegation, U.S. Federal Communications Commission, ETSI, and the European Internet Forum. Elsewhere at the show, our wireless leaders participated in GSMA-hosted 6G executive dialogues and roundtables on the research shaping the path to 6G. InterDigital was also a proud supporter of the AI Telco Troubleshooting Challenge, which awarded three teams for developing AI models that support more resilient, efficient and automated networks. ## Related INSIGHTS Explore the latest research and innovations in wireless, video, and AI technologies.
